Name: Replacement Sensor Model Identification Version A
Description: The Replacement Sensor Model Polynomial Coefficients TRE (RSMPC) contains the polynomial coefficients and related data needed to define a RSM (rational) polynomial ground-to-image function. The polynomial takes a ground position within the RSM ground domain into a corresponding image position within the RSM image domain. In particular, within a specific section in the RSM image domain, as specified by the fields RSN and CSN. The coordinates of the polynomial image position output are with respect to the original full image.

IID.Name: Image Identifier
IID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the original full image that corresponds to the associated image. This is not to be confused with the identification of an image derived by filtering, chipping, re-sampling, or other such image to image transformations.

EDITION.Name: RSM Image Support Data Edition
EDITION.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the RSM support data for the associated original full image. It is to consist of an identifier of up to 20 characters for the processor that generated the RSM support data, to which is appended up to 20 characters that are unique among RSM TRE sets that are generated by that processor.

RSN.Name: Row Section Number
RSN.Description: This field contains the image row section number that the following polynomial coefficients apply to.

CSN.Name: Column Section Number
CSN.Description: This field contains the image column section number that the following polynomial coefficients apply to.

RFEP.Name: Row Fitting Error
RFEP.Description: This field contains the rms fit error estimate applicable to the row rational polynomial relative to the original sensor model ground-to-image function. The value of RFEP assumes that an RSM ground-to-image (correction) grid is not employed, if available. The value of RFEP is non-negative.

RNRMO.Name: Row Normalization Offset
RNRMO.Description: This field contains the offset used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized image row coordinates r for the ground-to-image rational polynomial.

CNRMO.Name: Column Normalization Offset
CNRMO.Description: This field contains the offset used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized image column coordinates c for the ground-to-image rational polynomial.

XNRMO.Name: X Normalization Offset
XNRMO.Description: This field contains the offset used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized ground coordinates x for the ground-to-image rational polynomial.

YNRMO.Name: Y Normalization Offset
YNRMO.Description: This field contains the offset used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized ground coordinates y for the ground-to-image rational polynomial.

ZNRMO.Name: Z Normalization Offset
ZNRMO.Description: This field contains the offset used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized ground coordinates z for the ground-to-image rational polynomial.

RNRMSF.Name: Row Normalization Scale Factor
RNRMSF.Description: This field contains the scale factor used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized image row coordinates r for the ground-to-image rational polynomial.

CNRMSF.Name: Column Normalization Scale Factor
CNRMSF.Description: This field contains the scale factor used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized image column coordinates c for the ground to image rational polynomial.

XNRMSF.Name: X Normalization Scale Factor
XNRMSF.Description: This field contains the scale factor used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized ground coordinates x for the ground-to-image rational polynomial.

YNRMSF.Name: Y Normalization Scale Factor
YNRMSF.Description: This field contains the scale factor used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized ground coordinates y for the ground to image rational polynomial.

ZNRMSF.Name: Z Normalization Scale Factor
ZNRMSF.Description: This field contains the scale factor used in the defining relationship between un-normalized and normalized ground coordinates z for the ground to image rational polynomial.

RNPWRX.Name: Row Numerator Polynomial Maximum Power of X
RNPWRX.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized x coordinate used in the image section row numerator polynomial.

RNPWRY.Name: Row Numerator Polynomial Maximum Power of Y
RNPWRY.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized y coordinate used in the image section row numerator polynomial.

RNPWRZ.Name: Row Numerator Polynomial Maximum Power of Z
RNPWRZ.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized z coordinate used in the image section row numerator polynomial.

RNTRMS.Name: Row Numerator Polynomial Number of Polynomial Terms
RNTRMS.Description: This field contains the number of terms (coefficients) in the image section row numerator polynomial.

RNPCF.Name: Polynomial Coefficient
RNPCF.Description: This field contains one coefficient of the image section row numerator polynomial.

RDPWRX.Name: Row Denominator Polynomial Maximum Power of X
RDPWRX.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized x coordinate used in the image section row denominator polynomial.

RDPWRY.Name: Row Denominator Polynomial Maximum Power of Y
RDPWRY.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized y coordinate used in the image section row denominator polynomial.

RDPWRZ.Name: Row Denominator Polynomial Maximum Power of Z
RDPWRZ.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized z coordinate used in the image section row denominator polynomial.

RDTRMS.Name: Row Denominator Polynomial Number of Polynomial Terms
RDTRMS.Description: This field contains the number of terms (coefficients) in the image section row denominator polynomial.

RDPCF.Name: Polynomial Coefficient
RDPCF.Description: This field contains one coefficient of the image section row denominator polynomial.

CNPWRX.Name: Column Numerator Polynomial Maximum Power of X
CNPWRX.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized x coordinate used in the image section column numerator polynomial.

CNPWRY.Name: Column Numerator Polynomial Maximum Power of Y
CNPWRY.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized y coordinate used in the image section column numerator polynomial.

CNPWRZ.Name: Column Numerator Polynomial Maximum Power of Z
CNPWRZ.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized z coordinate used in the image section column numerator polynomial.

CNTRMS.Name: Column Numerator Polynomial Number of Polynomial Terms
CNTRMS.Description: This field contains the number of terms (coefficients) in the image section column numerator polynomial..

CNPCF.Name: Polynomial Coefficient
CNPCF.Description: This field contains one coefficient of the image section column numerator polynomial.

CDPWRX.Name: Column Denominator Polynomial Maximum Power of X
CDPWRX.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized x coordinate used in the image section column denominator polynomial.

CDPWRY.Name: Column Denominator Polynomial Maximum Power of Y
CDPWRY.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized y coordinate used in the image section column denominator polynomial.

CDPWRZ.Name: Column Denominator Polynomial Maximum Power of Z
CDPWRZ.Description: This field contains the maximum power of normalized z coordinate used in the image section column denominator polynomial.

CDPCF.Name: Polynomial Coefficient
CDPCF.Description: This field contains one coefficient of the image section column denominator polynomial.
